I5.quote: This study presents the utilization of activated carbons (ACs) derived from Polypodium vulgare, a commonly available feedstock, for effective medium-pressure H2 storage.

notes: Primary research article (Fuel 2024), record not retracted, no retraction notice, no statement that the H2 data were published before. The paper does not name the uptake method as volumetric or gravimetric; it names only the sorption analyzer (QUADRASORB evo, a manometric/volumetric instrument), and Section 2.2 says it was used 'at ambient pressure' while the H2 isotherms run to 45 bar, an internal inconsistency for extractors to note. H2 isotherms at 25-100 °C only (no 77 K); uptake in mmol/g with paired wt% in the Conclusions (p. 10); cycling data in Fig. 12 and SI Fig. S1. Surface area is BET, N2 at -196 °C, P/P0 0.05-0.25 (Section 2.2). Table 1 elemental analysis is of the precursor, not the ACs; carbon-sorbent status rests on the materials being KOH-activated carbons.
